description: Human-in-the-loop approval: ask the agent's human owner to approve, deny or edit ONE proposed action before you run it (refunds, emails, deletes, deploys, payments, or any guard 'review' verdict). Pushes a one-tap review link via ntfy, Slack, Discord or a webhook (or returns it with link_only). Returns id, poll_token, wait_url and approval_url (give approval_url only to the reviewer). Then call askhuman_status until status != pending. Fails closed: no answer before timeout = denied. Paid x402 $0.03 USDC on Base (invalid input or a failed notification is not charged).

tool.description: Tool the agent wants to call

callback_url.description: https URL for an HMAC-signed decision callback

link_only.description: No push; you show approval_url to the human yourself

ntfy_topic.description: ntfy.sh topic the owner subscribes to (8-64 chars A-Za-z0-9_-)

name: askhuman_request
